fact: UNESCO-IICBA says Lesotho's district education offices collect, validate and transmit school-level information into the national EMIS, which runs on DHIS2.
The Ministry of Education and Training is developing LEMIS on DHIS2 covering 4,819 institutions, not yet live for nationwide collection.

A ministry officer writing for GPE KIX says Lesotho's education ministry is making a transition to an EMIS operating system that can process both aggregated and individual data, alongside a draft EMIS policy.
